work_identified: De Linguae Phoenicis sive Hebraicae excellentia & de necessario illius & Arabicae penes Latinos usu, Praefatio, aut potius loquutionis humanaeue perfectionis Panegyris — Guillaume Postel, Vienna 1554 (VD16 P4481). A Latin preface/panegyric on the excellence of the Hebrew/Phoenician language and the necessity of it and Arabic for Latin scholars, composed during Postel's professorship at the Vienna Academy.
